messages.author: 3646363f2b56d518
messages.subject: assigning names to mlgs in genclone object
parts:
Hi, 

First off, very happy with poppr -  it's making my data analysis a lot easier!

My question: I'm relatively new to R and poppr.  I want to use the mlg.table function barplots, but I'd like to change the mlg names on the x axis  from the default numbers to those I have in my database. How can I go about doing this? 

If it's of any use, I included the MLG names as a stratum when i imported my dataset.

Thanks,

Jay

messages.author: d192ec4b1d416345
messages.subject: Re: [poppr] assigning names to mlgs in genclone object
parts:
Hi Jay,

You can use the mll.custom function to define your custom multilocus genotypes.

You can find a small example in the Multilocus Genotype Analysis vignette: https://cran.r-project.org/web/packages/poppr/vignettes/mlg.html#custom-custom

Hope that helps!

Zhian
